loop.top3_why: The weighted:pooled_meta_model strategy (A) achieves the best per‑window performance on the most recent window (0.523) and is only 0.0010 worse than the best overall score. The per‑window spread is also the smallest among the three candidates, indicating more consistent performance.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B (inverse_error) is slightly worse on the last window and its weighting scheme is highly sensitive to the limited number of validation windows, increasing variance. Candidate C (mean) is a very stable but less discriminative baseline; it performs slightly worse on the last window and offers no mechanism to adjust for the strong seasonal signal or the unstable model ranking. Given the diagnosis that a robust combination is preferred, the weighted meta‑model strikes the best balance between adaptivity and stability.
